scope: Fresh synthetic browser contexts; visible journey UI with mocked MAIA responses; no provider call, production write, or direct database audit.

results.detail: Arrival begins as a Future Self journey; Across Time and the seven-part operator UI are absent.
The threshold offers two intelligible entry doors before any future imagery is requested.
The member sees four experiential phases, while Keep remains unavailable before Return.
Future taxonomy is secondary; the journey first asks the member to let time open.
The future is encountered phenomenologically before interpretation.
Dialogue appears after encounter and both temporal voices remain member-entered.
Discernment begins with meaning; uncertainty/counterevidence stays optional behind disclosure.
Return is completed before initial Keep becomes available.
One explicit gesture hands the whole returned journey to MAIA with imaginal provenance and no retyping.
The synthesis becomes a continuing MAIA conversation without resending the journey manually.
Carry is optional and Nothing yet is a complete choice.
Across Time appears only after a journey has actually been kept.
Across Time uses human language while the temporal architecture remains underneath.
Across Time notes are not silently discarded on navigation.
Across Time opens a new journey with exact-source identity and explicit epistemic framing.
An unfinished journey may be explicitly discarded without inventing Return.
The kept journey preserves member-authored dialogue, imagined-future provenance, and a no-repeat MAIA doorway.
Deleting the only kept journey returns Across Time to unavailable.
The Future Self threshold fits a 390px mobile viewport without horizontal overflow.
The guided journey remains width-safe after entering the experience.
Visible mobile actions meet the 16px type and 44px target floors.
The bounded witness produced no page errors or off-origin browser requests.
The preview keeps provider access behind the explicit MAIA handoff seam.
